summative_rubric.title: Balance Stories — Summative Rubric

rows.expectation_text: identify quantities that can change and quantities that always remain the same in real-life contexts

levels.descriptor: Cannot distinguish change from constant. Treats today's count as fixed.
Independently sorts most cases. Names own examples of each.
Articulates the WHY (definition vs experience). Generalises to new contexts.

rows.expectation_text: determine whether given pairs of addition and subtraction expressions are equivalent or not

levels.descriptor: Reads = as 'gives the answer'. Cannot test equivalence.
Tests with prompts. Sometimes treats expression-on-both-sides as wrong.
Independently tests pairs. Uses = and ≠ correctly. Solves missing-number problems.

rows.expectation_text: identify and use equivalent relationships for whole numbers up to 50, in various contexts

levels.descriptor: Lists 0-2 equivalent expressions for any number.
Lists 3-4 with prompts. Mostly uses addition only.
Lists 5+ varied expressions for numbers up to 50. Uses both + and -.
Lists 8+ varied including 3-term sums. Uses subtraction creatively.

summative_rubric.usage_notes: Apply this rubric to each child's combined evidence.

summative_task_script.title: Lesson 5 Summative Task — Balance Story
administration_steps: Walk through the Balance Story Template.
summative_task_script.scoring_guidance: Story coherence (out of 3) + correct equation (out of 3) + equivalent expression (out of 2) + drawing matches story (out of 2) = 10.

evidence_per_expectation.C2.1: Story includes a CHANGE element OR identifies the situation as varying.
evidence_per_expectation.C2.2: Equation uses = correctly to show same amount.
evidence_per_expectation.C2.3: Provides at least one equivalent expression for the total.
